title: Foundry Ontology Design for Beneficial-Ownership Networks — Person, Entity, Officer, and Jurisdiction Modeling at Bank-Group Scale
validation_scope: Ontology schema covers Person, Entity, Jurisdiction, OWNS, OFFICER_OF, and REGISTERED_IN with temporal properties.
Synthetic data set includes 200 entities and multi-jurisdiction disclosure metadata.
Cypher queries include as-of-date beneficial-ownership traversal and provenance inspection.

BOI rule references are structural only; live compliance status must still be checked at publication time.
